# List of source file paths
source_files = [

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_46/training_12.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_46/training_13.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_46/training_14.csv"
]

# Step 1: Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure the column 'purpose' is integer type as per target schema
    df['purpose'] = df['purpose'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Step 2: UNION all source tables (concatenate vertically)
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Step 3: Aggregate by summing the 'purpose' column across all source tables
# Since the operation_history specifies no group_by columns, sum all 'purpose' values
total_purpose_sum = union_df['purpose'].sum()

# Step 4: Create the target DataFrame with the aggregated sum as a single-row DataFrame
target_df = pd.DataFrame({'purpose': [total_purpose_sum]})

# Step 5: Write the result to the specified target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_46/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
